supporting_quotes.exact: A Red-Black Tree is a self-balancing binary search tree with a height limit of O(logN), enabling efficient search, insertion, and deletion operations in O(logN) time, unlike standard binary search trees which can take O(N) time.

observations.subject: red-black-tree
observations.object: self-balancing binary search tree with height limit O(logN); search/insertion/deletion in O(logN); unlike standard BST which can take O(N)

claims.rationale: 引文证据证据片段 [0,228)（整段引文）逐字对应 claim 全部组成：自平衡二叉搜索树、高度上限 O(logN)、查找/插入/删除 O(logN) 高效、普通 BST 最坏 O(N)；无附加条件或推演缺口。注：offset 相对本审计可见的引文片段（source 全文未提供，无法给出全文档绝对偏移）。

supporting_quotes.exact: Node Color: Each node is either red or black.
Root Property: The root of the tree is always black.
Red Node Property: Red nodes cannot have red children (Red nodes cannot be adjacent).
Black Node Property: Every path from a node to its descendant leaves must have the same number of black nodes.
Leaf Property: All leaves (NIL nodes) are black.

observations.subject: red-black-tree-node
observations.object: either red or black

observations.subject: red-black-tree-root
observations.object: always black

observations.subject: red-node
observations.object: red children (red nodes cannot be adjacent)

observations.subject: path-from-node-to-descendant-leaves
observations.object: same number of black nodes

observations.subject: leaves (NIL nodes)
observations.object: black

claims.rationale: claim 列出五条性质，每条分别由一段引文直接陈述：节点颜色 [0,45)、根黑 [0,52)、红节点无红子（不可相邻）[0,85)、黑高相同 [0,110)、NIL 叶黑 [0,48)；五段引文与 claim 五条一一对应且无遗漏、无多余。注：offset 相对本审计可见的引文片段。

supporting_quotes.exact: These properties (no two consecutive reds and same black height) ensure that the longest path from the root to any leaf is no more than twice as long as the shortest path, maintaining the tree's balance and efficient performance.

observations.subject: red-black-tree-properties
observations.object: longest root-to-leaf path is at most twice the shortest path, maintaining balance and efficient performance

claims.rationale: 引文 [0,229) 完整陈述 claim 的因果链：上述性质（无连续红、黑高相同）确保最长路径不超过最短路径两倍，从而维持平衡与高效性能；claim 所述（含括号内注解）与引文逐项吻合。注：offset 相对本审计可见的引文片段。

supporting_quotes.exact: Insertion: Inserting a new node involves a two-step process: BST insertion, followed by fixing Red-Black property violations.

observations.subject: inserting-a-new-node
observations.object: two-step process: BST insertion, then fixing Red-Black property violations

claims.rationale: 引文 [0,125) 直接陈述两步流程：先 BST 插入，再修复红黑性质违规；与 claim 的"先按 BST 规则插入，再修复红黑性质违规"完全对应。注：offset 相对本审计可见的引文片段。

supporting_quotes.exact: Case 1 (Uncle is Red): Recolor parent and uncle to black, grandparent to red. Then, move up the tree.

observations.subject: case-1-insertion-fix (uncle is red)
observations.object: recolor parent and uncle to black, grandparent to red, then move up the tree

claims.rationale: 引文 [0,101) 完整对应 claim 情形一：叔节点为红时父/叔改黑、祖父改红、向上（move up the tree）继续修复；三处操作与 claim 逐项一致。注：offset 相对本审计可见的引文片段。

supporting_quotes.exact: Case 2 (Uncle is Black): If node is a right child, perform a left rotation on the parent. If the node is a left child, perform a right rotation on the grandparent and recolor.

observations.subject: case-2-insertion-fix (uncle is black)
observations.object: if right child: left rotation on parent; if left child: right rotation on grandparent and recolor

claims.rationale: 引文 [0,175) 与 claim 情形二逐项对应：右孩子→父节点左旋，左孩子→祖父节点右旋+重新着色；条件与操作完全一致，无引申。注：offset 相对本审计可见的引文片段。

observations.object: BST searching

claims.rationale: 引文 [0,121) 逐字对应 claim：在节点 x 向左旋转（pivots to the left），右孩子 y 提升到 x 原位置；无附加前提。注：offset 相对本审计可见的引文片段。

Suitable for use in maps, sets, and priority queues.
